meta.title: Pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Well-differentiated pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (pNET), sporadic and syndromic
meta.population: Adults with well-differentiated pancreatic NET - THE FUNCTIONAL-SYNDROME FAMILY and the cavity where the registry's NET story completes its reciprocal pair: the GI-NET trainer holds the shared family receipts (SSA foundation, PRRT arc, WHO 2019 grade discipline, crisis correction) and REROUTES LIVE both ways (gi-net.html = the registry's EIGHTEENTH live reroute). What pNET adds is its own: THE 2011 PHASE-3 PAIR verified verbatim (sunitinib 11.4 vs 5.5, HR 0.42, PMID 21306237; everolimus RADIANT-3 11.0 vs 4.6, HR 0.35, PMID 21306238 - ADJACENT PMIDs from one NEJM issue, approved fifteen days apart, the first new pNET drugs in ~30 years); E2211's CAPTEM receipt at exact grade (randomized PHASE II - correction 34th - PFS 22.7 vs 14.4 verified, OS NULL: 58.7 vs 53.8, p=0.42; MGMT exploratory only); the FUNCTIONAL SYNDROMES (60-90% nonfunctional - insulinoma's >90% surgical cure, gastrinoma's duodenal predominance and PPI masking, the glucagonoma 4Ds, VIPoma's WDHA); the GERMLINE LAYER with the registry's newest genotype card (belzutifan - VHL-pNET approved 2021-08-13, verified; MEN1 ~10% syndromic slice with the Thakker-2012 trap corrected); and THE INCIDENTALOMA RESTRAINT FRONTIER as signature - small (<=2cm) nonfunctional sporadic pNETs earn SURVEILLANCE on prospective-cohort receipts (ASPEN interim verified; PANDORA's 3%-growth-to-resection figure with its honest QoL wrinkle) - NO randomized trial exists, and this run's own two sweeps CONFLICT on whether ASPEN's final analysis has published (logged, re-check queued).
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the pancreatic side of the NET family. THE RECIPROCAL PAIR: gi-net.html reroutes live both ways (18th reroute) - shared receipts live there, cited by reference, never re-verified. PNET'S OWN CHAPTERS: (1) THE INCIDENTALOMA RESTRAINT FRONTIER (signature): sporadic asymptomatic nonfunctional pNET <=2cm earns active surveillance on prospective-cohort evidence - ASPEN (interim BJS 2022 verified: surveillance safe, zero distant metastases at ~2 years) and PANDORA (BJS 2021: only 3% grew to resection at 17 months - WITH the honest wrinkle taught: surveilled…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: WHO 2019 GEP-NEN grading (shared discipline - held in the GI-NET trainer: G3-NET vs NEC by morphology, never Ki-67 alone); profile router = small-incidental (<=2cm NF sporadic) / localized-resectable / advanced G1-G2 / advanced G3-NET; germline axis (sporadic / MEN1 / VHL) as pNET's own router - the belzutifan gate; functional-syndrome axis as the parallel care layer
meta.response: Cross-sectional + SSTR imaging conventions (shared); hormone-level control as the functional syndromes' own endpoint; stability-is-success inherited from the family

Newly diagnosed.name: Active surveillance (small incidental - the restraint chapter)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: active surveillance for <=2cm NF sporadic pNET (ASPEN/PANDORA cohort receipts; ENETS-aligned)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: prospective cohort x2 (interim/complete); NO RCT - said; conflict logged
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: none physical; the QoL wrinkle is the honest cost
Newly diagnosed.patient: For a small, symptom-free tumor of this type found by accident: careful watching - proven safe in two large prospective studies where almost none progressed and none spread.

Newly diagnosed.name: Resection (localized, surgery-indicated - the operating room)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: surgical conventions (enucleation/formal by anatomy; NANETS/ENETS secondhand)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: convention + SEER anchors; adjuvant question in-trial
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: pancreatic surgery's real ledger - fistula, delayed emptying, endocrine/exocrine insufficiency
Newly diagnosed.patient: For localized tumors that have earned an operation: surgery - sometimes just shelling the tumor out, sometimes a formal pancreatic resection - with cure the goal.

Newly diagnosed.name: The deep shelf, sequenced (advanced G1-G2)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the pNET systemic standards (five receipted classes; sequence unproven - said)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: verified randomized receipts x5 at their exact grades
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: class-dependent: TKI / mTOR / alkylator / radioligand ledgers - sequenced, not stacked
Newly diagnosed.patient: For advanced disease: the deepest set of proven options in rare oncology - a monthly injection first, then two targeted pills from 2011, an oral chemotherapy pair, the newest 2025 pill, and the radioactive infusion - chosen in sequence over years.
drugs: SSA foundation, then sunitinib / everolimus / CAPTEM / cabozantinib / 177Lu-DOTATATE (conference-sequenced)

Newly diagnosed.name: Belzutifan (VHL-associated pNET - the genotype card)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 2 basis + verified approval; pNET-subset ORR held
Newly diagnosed.patient: For pancreatic tumors caused by VHL disease: a daily pill aimed at the exact broken pathway - approved in 2021, often letting surgery wait.

Newly diagnosed.name: G3-NET conventions (shared discipline + pNET's own receipts)
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the fastest-dividing well-differentiated tumors: chemotherapy first - and the newest targeted pill now has data specifically in this situation.
drugs: CAPTEM or platinum-etoposide, then cabozantinib (G3 subgroup receipt)

Newly diagnosed.name: Comfort-focused care
Newly diagnosed.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Newly diagnosed.patient: Comfort-focused care is a real choice at every step - often a years-long chapter in this slow family, with hormone-symptom treatment continuing.
drugs: Palliative care partnership (hormone control continuing where functional)

Relapsed / recurrent.name: The next rung (the deepest shelf, re-sequenced)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: sequenced shelf conventions (no sequence trial - said; the head-to-head enrolling)
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: verified class receipts; sequence evidence absent
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: When one option stops working: the next proven one - this disease's shelf is deep enough that progression usually means re-sequencing, not running out.
drugs: Next-rung therapy from the shelf (TKI / mTOR / CAPTEM / cabozantinib / 177Lu - conference-sequenced)

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Refractory-syndrome control (the hormone layer's own escalation)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: syndrome-control conventions + one live phase-3 door (upLIFT)

Relapsed / recurrent.patient: When the hormones are the bigger problem than the tumor: an escalation plan of its own - including, for stubborn low blood sugar, a first-of-its-kind antibody now in late-stage testing with promising early results.
drugs: Syndrome-directed therapy (diazoxide/PPI/repletion craft; ersodetug via trial; liver-directed control)

refs.label: THE 2011 PAIR, verified verbatim: sunitinib (Raymond, NEJM 2011 - PMID 21306237, pubmed-url-match): PFS 11.4 (7.4-19.8) vs 5.5 (3.6-7.4), HR 0.42 (0.26-0.66); early stop memory-grade; FDA 2011-05-20. Everolimus RADIANT-3 (Yao, NEJM 2011 - PMID 21306238, matched): PFS 11.0 vs 4.6, HR 0.35 (0.27-0.45); FDA 2011-05-05. THE ADJACENT-PMID TRAP documented (...237 = sunitinib; ...238 = everolimus - same NEJM issue, approvals 15 days apart, first new pNET drugs in ~30 years). THE NEAR-IDENTICAL-MEDIANS TRAP: 11.4 / 11.0 / CABINET-interim 11.4 - keep the HRs attached (0.42/0.35/0.23) as disambiguators | PMID 21306237 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

E2211 AT HONEST GRADE (correction 34th): randomized PHASE II - not phase 3 (PMID 36260828, JCO 2023): CAPTEM vs temozolomide in advanced pNET - PFS 22.7 vs 14.4 months (verified snippet); OS NULL: 58.7 vs 53.8, HR 0.82, p=0.42; RR 40% vs 34% (p=0.59) - the crown is PFS+response, never survival. MGMT: exploratory ORs 6.38 (low IHC) / 9.79 (promoter methylation) for response - 'predicts response in E2211's exploratory analysis,' NEVER 'biomarker-directed therapy' (guidelines do not mandate testing). MGMT-NET (French, randomized ph2) subsequently MISSED its primary endpoint - the selection question stays open | PMID 36260828 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

ASPEN (NCT03084770) - the restraint signature's receipt, at exact grade: prospective OBSERVATIONAL multicenter cohort (NOT randomized - none exists anywhere), sporadic asymptomatic NF-pNET <=2cm; INTERIM verified (BJS 2022 - PMID 35986682, pubmed-url-match: surveillance safe, minimal growth, zero distant metastases, ~2yr median). THE CONFLICT RESOLVED (refresh 2026-08-20 - both sweeps partially right): the 'final analysis' is an ESMO 2025 CONGRESS ABSTRACT (LBA36, Ann Oncol abstract supplement, DOI 10.1016/j.annonc.2025.09.047, presented Berlin 2025-10): N=1000, median follow-up 42 months, 20 deaths (18 surveillance/2 surgery; 19 unrelated to pNET; the ONE pNET-related death was in the SURGERY arm), OS p=0.53 - surveillance safe; NO full-length final manuscript exists - the 2022 BJS interim remains the only full paper. Abstract-grade, labeled. THE NAME-COLLISION TRAP: 'ASPEN' also names the brensocatib bronchiectasis phase 3 (NEJM 2025) - always tag NCT03084770/Partelli | PMID 35986682 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

PANDORA (Dutch nationwide prospective watchful-waiting cohort, BJS 2021 - journal-URL verified; NO NCT exists - Netherlands Trial Register NL6510): sporadic asymptomatic NF-pNET <=2cm - only 2/76 (3%) grew to resection at median 17 months. THE HONEST WRINKLE TAUGHT: surveilled patients' QoL DECREASED and protocol adherence was low - watching has a psychological price, and the restraint card says so

THE FUNCTIONAL FAMILY (mirror-verified conventions): 60-90% of pNETs NONFUNCTIONAL (StatPearls NBK448121); INSULINOMA (Whipple triad; ~90% benign; ~10% MEN1; surgical cure >90% - verified; diazoxide bridging; SSA-caution craft); GASTRINOMA (ZES; duodenal predominance strongest in MEN1-ZES; MEN1 in ~20-30% of ZES; PPI masking); GLUCAGONOMA (the 4Ds + diarrhea the 'missed fifth D' - Autopsy & Case Reports; typically >5cm, ~75% metastatic at diagnosis); VIPOMA (WDHA/Verner-Morrison; ~1 per 10 million/yr); somatostatinoma triad (memory-grade convention)

THE GERMLINE LAYER (correction 37th applied): ~10% of pNETs syndromic (MEN1 largest slice - the MEN1-specific 5-10% figure memory-grade, worded as bundle); pNET penetrance in MEN1 30-80% (Dutch MEN1 Study Group, JCEM 2017 - journal-verified); gastrinoma-MEN1 ~20-30%. THE THAKKER TRAP CORRECTED: the 2012 MEN1 guideline (PMID 22990066) calls small-NF management 'controversial' and hedges at <1cm - it does NOT state the <2cm-observe rule; anchor the convention to the Dutch cohort + the 2025 recommendations (Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol best-practice + Brandi Delphi consensus). THE FALLING-THRESHOLD HEDGE: one 2024 series (38662083) found ~25% P/LP yield in apparently-sporadic pNET - a hedge line, not a headline

THE GENOTYPE CARD, verified: belzutifan FDA-approved 2021-08-13 for VHL disease requiring therapy for RCC, CNS hemangioblastoma, OR pNET 'not requiring immediate surgery' (FDA approval summary - PMID 35727604, pubmed-url-match; LITESPARK-004, n=61). THE TRAP HELD: the 49% ORR in snippets is the RCC figure - the pNET-subset ORR is deliberately NOT quoted pending the FDA-summary re-read. LITESPARK-015 cohort A2 (NCT04924075) = the SPORADIC-pNET HIF-2a door (progressed G1/G2 after targeted therapy; ESMO 2025 presented; ORR UNVERIFIED); the 2025 pheo/PGL indication is adjacent, not pNET | PMID 35727604 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE LABEL-VS-EVIDENCE CHAPTER (verified both halves + correction 38th): NETTER-1 was MIDGUT-ONLY - pancreatic primaries EXCLUDED - yet the 2018-01-26 Lutathera label covers ALL SSTR+ GEP-NETs including pancreas (NCI-verified) - pNET PRRT rode the label ahead of its randomized evidence; NETTER-R (retrospective pNET) bridged; NETTER-2 INCLUDED pNET (first-line high-G2/G3). THE COMPETE CORRECTION (38th): the pNET post-hoc subgroup (n=178, ENETS 2026) - PFS 24.5 vs 14.7, HR 0.70 (0.45-1.09), p=0.114 - NOT SIGNIFICANT (ORR 33.3% vs 3.6% favors ITM-11): say 'overall trial positive; pNET subgroup trend only.' The ITM-11 CRL story is shared (held in the gi-net trainer)

CABINET's pNET COHORT AT FINAL NUMBERS (correction 35th): NEJM 2024 final - pNET PFS 13.8 vs 4.4 months, HR 0.23 (NEJM-cited; approved 2025-03-26 - shared regulatory receipt). THE TRANSPOSITION TRAP: the interim/press figure (11.4 vs 3.0) numerically COLLIDES with sunitinib's 11.4 - cite the final only. THE CONFLATION TRAP: one snippet renders 13.8 as 'median follow-up' - it is the pNET median PFS. THE G3 DELTA: the CABINET grade-3 well-differentiated subgroup publication (PMID 41524552, pubmed-url-match) gives G3-pNET a therapy anchor the shared receipts lack | PMID 39282913 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

STREPTOZOCIN AS HISTORY (verified both receipts): Moertel NEJM 1992 (PMID 1310159, pubmed-url-match: strep+doxorubicin superior to strep+5FU in advanced islet-cell carcinoma) + Moertel NEJM 1980 (6252466, matched: strep+5FU vs strep alone). THE TWO-MOERTEL TRAP: the 'strep+dox superior' claim belongs to 1992 ONLY. Superseded in practice by CAPTEM/targeted (convention) - one honest line of history | PMID 1310159 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE RE-ANCHORED LEDGER (correction 36th): SEER/ACS 5-yr relative survival - localized 95% / regional 72-74% / distant 23-27% / all-stage ~53% (mirror-verified); metastatic trial-population median ~4.5-5 years (E2211's 53.8-58.7 months) - the briefing's '5-8 years' softened; Yao 2008 SEER era-anchor (distant pNET median ~24 months, 1973-2004 - PRE-everolimus/sunitinib/PRRT, the caveat carried); primary site independently prognostic (pNET worse than small-bowel stage-for-stage, directionally verified)

THE OPERATING ROOM'S TRADES (convention-grade, deliberately textbook): enucleation spares parenchyma but runs HIGH postoperative-pancreatic-fistula rates (the mortality-for-morbidity trade); Whipple/distal-pancreatectomy morbidity honesty; insulinoma enucleation for small superficial lesions clear of the duct (cure >90% verified); the Landmark Series (Ann Surg Oncol 2025, doi 10.1245/s10434-025-17390-x) available as the citation when wanted; liver debulking = shared GI-trainer receipts, no pNET-specific delta found

SURUFATINIB'S US FATE, exact (correction 39a): SANET-p (China) positive -> US NDA -> CRL ~2022-05 (FDA required a multi-regional trial; COVID inspection issues contributory) - CRL, NOT withdrawal; resubmittable in principle; NO US resubmission or MRCT registered (the US pathway is a verified desert); approved in China. A Chinese adjuvant trial (NCT06158516) exists - geography UNVERIFIED, presumed not a US door

THE CORRECTED DESERT (39th): ersodetug (RZ358 - insulin-receptor antibody, Rezolute) phase 3 upLIFT (NCT06881992): tumor hyperinsulinism (insulinoma + non-islet-cell tumor hypoglycemia), single-arm ~16 pts - POSITIVE INTERIM 2026-06-02, topline 2H 2026, FDA 'streamlined pathway' per press (all secondhand) - refractory-insulinoma hypoglycemia is NO LONGER a trial desert; gastrinoma's desert, by contrast, VERIFIED (only legacy NIH natural-history; no recruiting interventional trial found)

THE GRAVEYARD + THE IMPORT TRAP: checkpoint monotherapy null (KEYNOTE-158 GEP cohort ORR 3.7% - shared receipt, includes pNET); PAZONET (pazopanib ph2, PFS ~9.5mo) = abandoned-not-failed (said precisely); AXINET (axitinib) failed in EXTRAPANCREATIC NET - the import trap: never carry it onto a pNET card; BEZ235 (NCT01658436) stopped for futility; MGMT-NET missed its primary endpoint (JCO 2024). None carded (property)

THE DOORS + THE DESERTS: SWOG S2104 (NCT05040360 - adjuvant CAPTEM vs observation, high-risk resected pNET, RECRUITING US - the adjuvant desert's first randomized answer); NCT05247905 (CAPTEM vs 177Lu head-to-head, advanced pNET, US NCI - the sequencing question randomized); combination doors UNVERIFIED (sunitinib+Lutathera NCT05687123; peposertib+Lutathera NCT04750954); ADJUPANET (NCT07591493 - first ph3 adjuvant pNET, France, NOT YET RECRUITING, not a US door, completion ~2035); shared radioligand doors ALL pNET-eligible (COMPOSE incl. pancreatic, est. completion 2026-09; ACTION-1 pancreas-listed; AlphaMedix; VMT-alpha-NET - ASCO 2026 cut ORR 39%, updating the 43% interim on the GI card, noted). DESERTS VERIFIED: gastrinoma trials; MEN1 interventional trials (2025 = guidelines only); US surufatinib

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.
